profile.name: Fahkumram
profile.overview: Fahkumram is a long range powerhouse with many ways to power through the opponent's defenses with his strong string mix ups or using his install: Garuda Force, which leads to his new Rama Stance by guard crushing with his charged moves.
profile.playstyle: Long-range powerhouse. Poke from outside the opponent's reach with his long legs (3, uf+4, b+3+4), break their guard with string mix-ups and charged knees, and win big when Garuda Force (GRF) powers him up in Heat. He is slow up close, so do not let the opponent get inside for free.
strengths: Long Legs: Fahkumram sports some of the longest range in the game with moves such as 3, uf+4, df3, and the mighty b+3+4.
Hard Hitting: Fahkumram has consistent high damage on both his combos and his single hit pokes.
High Mix Potential: Many of Fahkumram's strings have multiple enders, and can lead to charged kicks that guard break with his Garuda Force install.

Garuda Force: Fahkumram's install makes his mixups more potent, adding a power low sweep and a guard break to his charged moves that on hit enters Rama stance. This makes you guess between a fast mid, a jailing mid high string, an unreactable low, a grab, or an unblockable mid.
weaknesses: Slow: Has slow start up on many of his moves, with many of his key moves being at least i13, meaning he's prone to interruption if not properly spaced or has not properly conditioned his opponent.

Tall Fighter: His range comes at a downside, in that his opponents can get longer combos against him and some moves that other characters could step normally clip his wide body. His jabs and even his standing 3 are more prone to getting evaded than other characters due to his sheer height.
Turn based: Plus frames are relegated to his okizeme and slower moves, so the "safe" mid options you have from his string mix ups give up your turn.
Linear: Many of Fahkumram's fast pokes and GRF mixups can be sidestepped, requiring conditioning of the opponent to stand still.

stances.name: Garuda Force
stances.entry: Heat activation, or a counter-hit d+4 throw
stances.note: A power-up install: GRF powers up specific moves and gives string extensions (Wavu).

stances.name: Rama Stance
stances.entry: Landing from GRF.1+2, df+3+4,GRF.3, GRF.4* and GRF.3*
stances.note: A landing stance only reachable through Garuda Force moves.

heat: Garuda Force powers up specific moves and gives string extensions.

keyMoves.summary: Ayutthaya: i13 long mid, -9 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: One of the longest pokes in the game (Wavu).
keyMoves.use: At range to poke and start strings.

keyMoves.gamePlan: A fast option, which he lacks elsewhere.

keyMoves.summary: i15 punish string that crumples on hit (+52cs).
Surging Elbow: i14 mid, evades jabs, launches (+34a). -13 on block.

keyMoves.use: After lows that are -15 or worse.

keyMoves.summary: Heavy Middle Kick: i18 mid, launches on counter hit (+58a).
keyMoves.purpose: A long CH launcher with good sidestep tracking.
keyMoves.use: At range when they step in.

keyMoves.summary: Lashing Squall: i18 high, +6 on block, launches on hit (+47a).
keyMoves.use: To keep the turn at range.
keyMoves.gamePlan: A scary high: make them duck, then mid them.

keyMoves.summary: Rumbling Thunder: i14 low, -15 on block; shifts to a throw and GRF on counter hit.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Low with a big CH reward.

keyMoves.summary: Thundershock Kick: i16 homing high, Heat Engager.
keyMoves.use: To start Heat and catch steps.

keyMoves.summary: Raging Knee: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
